# 

*Local guidance (St. Cloud CDSS, Inpatient):*
CDC web site (www.cdc.gov) and/or National Center for Infectious Diseases (www.cdc.gov/ncidod)
Neutropenic precautions must be ordered by a physician. All other precautions can be ordered by nursing staff.
Standard precautions
Airborne precautions
Use for chickenpox, disseminated zoster, and measles
Special respiratory precautions
Use for tuberculosis
Droplet precautions
Use for diphtheria, epiglottitis, meningococcal disease, respiratory or systemic Haemophilus influenzae disease, pertussis
Contact precautions
Use for patients known to be colonized by or infected with vancomycin-resistant enterococcus or other multi-drug resistant bacteria Neutropenic precautions
Use for patients with absolute neutrophil count less than 500 cells/ml
